name: Hangzhou Grascent Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Grascent Co., Ltd. is a China-based company primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sales of fragrance products. The company's main product lines consist of the turpentine oil series, the cypress oil series, and the fully synthetic series, which are used as ingredients in cosmetics and personal care products. The company exports its products to European and American markets.
